summary: Full E2E test of the ported EditFlow Pro Album Editor at /album (React + IndexedDB, local-first). All 8 requested flows verified end-to-end in a single browser session (IndexedDB requires session continuity). No console errors, no page errors during any flow.

flows_verified.1_load_and_create_album: PASS - /album shows 'Mis álbumes'. 'Nuevo álbum' + name 'Test Álbum' + 'Crear álbum' navigates to /album?project=albumproject_xxx. Editor shows Plantillas (23 en total), Propiedades, Fotos panels and 'Crea tu primer lienzo' empty state.
flows_verified.2_import_photos: PASS - Bottom Fotos panel '+ Archivos' opens hidden input[type=file]. set_input_files with 10 JPGs from /app/test_photos → toast 'Importación completa (10 nueva(s) · 0 preview(s) restaurada(s))' + strip shows '1–10 de 10' (note: en-dash, not hyphen).
flows_verified.3_manual_template: PASS - 'Nuevo lienzo' creates canvas. Clicking template 'Dos horizontales' in Plantillas fills central canvas with 2 slots showing 'Suelta una foto aquí' text.
flows_verified.4_auto_layout: PASS (core flow) - Ctrl+click multi-selection of 5 thumbs in bottom strip → button 'Maquetar automáticamente (5)' appears → opens 'Asistencia IA' config dialog (Máx. lienzos=20, Fotos por lienzo=6, Prioridad de reparto: Equilibrado/Más fotos/Más espacio) → clicking 'Analizar' shows preview 'Asistencia IA' with metrics (Fotografías analizadas=5, propuestas=5, Lienzos nuevos=1, Total final=1) + 'Aplicar propuesta' button → applying creates 1 lienzo with 5 photos placed, toast 'Maquetación completada · 5 fotografías analizadas · 1 lienzo(s) creado(s)'. Navigator shows 'Lienzo 1 / 1'.
flows_verified.5_validate: PASS - 'Validar maquetación' button opens 'Validación de la maquetación' dialog listing 5 impression-quality warnings (≥150 ppp advisory). Closes with Cerrar/Escape. Also auto-appears once after Aplicar propuesta.
flows_verified.6_undo_ctrl_z: PASS - Ctrl+Z reduces lienzos from 1 → 0 (navigator switches to 'Sin lienzos').
flows_verified.7_export: PASS - 'Exportar' in top toolbar opens 'Exportar lienzos' dialog with Para impresión / Revisión manual tabs, Formato de salida JPEG/PNG (spec said PDF/JPG - actual is JPEG/PNG), Calidad %, Resolución 150/300/600 DPI, Incluir sangrado, Exportar N lienzo(s) button. No console errors on open.
flows_verified.8_persistence: PASS - After creating 1 lienzo with 5 photos and waiting ~3s for autosave, reloading same ?project= URL restores 1 lienzo (Lienzo 1 / 1) and 10 photos ('1–10 de 10'). URL match preserved. IndexedDB autosave working.

action_items: Minor spec discrepancy: Export dialog offers JPEG/PNG not PDF/JPG as the review request states — confirm intended formats with product; not a bug.

UX consideration: A Validation dialog auto-opens after 'Aplicar propuesta'. This blocks other top-toolbar clicks (e.g., Exportar) until dismissed. If unintended, consider making it non-modal or auto-close.

Post-apply the resulting single-lienzo layout for 5 wedding photos produces 5 impression-quality warnings (~47–139 ppp < recommended 150). Layout is technically correct but users targeting print should be aware.
critical_code_review_comments: Module lacks data-testid attributes (as noted in the request). Tests must fall back to visible Spanish text. Recommend adding data-testid to key buttons (new-album, create-album, new-canvas, template-<id>, auto-layout, auto-layout-analyze, auto-layout-apply, validate, undo, redo, export, export-run) for robust automation.
IndexedDB is per-browser-context; each fresh Playwright launch starts empty. Not a bug, but noted for future test agents: run full flow within a single browser session or use persistent context.
The multi-selection (Ctrl+click) works but there is no visible 'X seleccionadas' counter on hover-clickable thumb (counter appears in the Fotos toolbar '5 seleccionadas x'). Fine as is.
Autosave debounce appears ~2-3s. Reloading immediately after edits may lose latest state; waited 3s and it persisted correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Album editor E2E works. Auto-layout core flow: multi-select thumbs (Ctrl+click) → button says 'Maquetar automáticamente (N)' → click → 'Asistencia IA' config dialog with button labeled 'Analizar' (NOT Continuar/Aplicar) → analysis → second 'Asistencia IA' preview dialog with button 'Aplicar propuesta' (NOT plain 'Aplicar'). Toast: 'Maquetación completada'. Validation dialog auto-appears afterward — dismiss it before clicking top-toolbar buttons like Exportar. IndexedDB persistence requires single browser session; test flow must not reload between actions unless testing persistence itself.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. All requested features working.
